pieces.content:
Polia,

We saw these scraps on a whiteboard—the one before the room—I mean outside it—I gathered or collected all that was possible: (x,y)

(14,54) You know a little basket can be found in a chimney or the reeds. And we will keep that chimney clear or hew those reeds as a collective good / (35,24) The particle-set of the leaves will flutter off the tree when the request is filled / (20,43) Not everyone can do this! / (17,90) August Bank Holiday Island? / Our lack of ourness (maybe areness) / (53,53) Problem with using is the User / (15,110) The boundary of this truce

(A placeholder: "most people are fools—most authority is malignant—God does not exist—and everything is wrong")
pieces.title: Ark refactoring

pieces.content: "Not only that, but this instantaneous ruin presents whole new vistas to the imagination. Let me show you what I mean. Suppose you walk to another section while your lover waits for God. In this state, you no longer need to know what you think is important; you don’t need to know how the buildings here came together. And your shoes are too tight."
pieces.readme: The appearance in a strife of love of a disc which parses information-places.
